messages:
rachel: Quick shout — VantaData just closed their ISV listing on GCP Marketplace and selected Redwood Dedicated for inference. Onboarding finished this morning, live in prod. :tada:

omar: Awesome — any immediate numbers from the validation run?

rachel: Pilot highlights: 40% fewer tokens billed for their rerank pipeline after enabling prefix cache + batch fusion; 1.7x higher throughput on our reserved instances vs their prior setup.

tess: Great win. Can marketing get a 1-2 sentence customer quote + a short tech blurb? I can draft the case study.

alex: FYI they required customer-managed keys + 90-day audit log retention. Ops ticket INF-4477 created and assigned.

priya: Legal signed the marketplace agreement this morning. legal-bot: Agreement ID AG-99823, approved by Priya.

dev-bot: GCP Marketplace listing live: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/details/vantadata/embed-cloud status=ACTIVE

rachel: For the external post, suggested bullets: 1) Marketplace listing + Dedicated for predictable latency. 2) 40% token savings via batching + quant profiles. 3) Enterprise security: CMK + audit logs.

omar: Sales asked to add VantaData to the enterprise references and include a renewal play bit. Ref: REF-VANTA-21.

tess: I'll schedule a 20-min quote call with their Head of Product tomorrow at 9am PT. Sending calendar invite now.

alex: Ops note: they opted into adaptive batching with a 150ms latency SLO for interactive queries. We flagged the route for 14-day retention in observability and set up canary rollouts. Ticket SRE-2310.

priya: Marketing please run the draft by security for the blurb. Also need their written consent for publishing the quote.

rachel: Tiny engineering snippet for the blog:

```
redwood.reserve_capacity(
  customer="vantadata",
  pool="dedicated-eu-west-1",
  min_instances=4,
  quant_profile="int8-v2",
  cache_prefixing=true
)
```

omar: Love it. Design request DGN-812 for a small architecture diagram sent.

tess: Draft uploaded to drive: https://drive.google.com/example-vanta  Please review by EOD.

alex: Closing the loop: runbooks shared, support rotation scheduled, and CS onboarding session at 3pm today. Congrats team! :rocket:
